node_kinds.name: BHK_Node
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes worker or control plane node.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Namespace
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes namespace providing resource isolation boundary.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Pod
node_kinds.description: Running Kubernetes pod instance.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Deployment
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Deployment workload controller.

node_kinds.name: BHK_DaemonSet
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes DaemonSet workload controller.

node_kinds.name: BHK_StatefulSet
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes StatefulSet workload controller.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Job
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Job workload.

node_kinds.name: BHK_CronJob
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes CronJob scheduled workload.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Service
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Service providing network access to a set of pods.

node_kinds.name: BHK_HTTPRoute
node_kinds.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute for HTTP/HTTPS traffic routing.

node_kinds.name: BHK_GRPCRoute
node_kinds.description: Gateway API GRPCRoute for gRPC traffic routing.

node_kinds.name: BHK_TCPRoute
node_kinds.description: Gateway API TCPRoute for raw TCP traffic routing.

node_kinds.name: BHK_TLSRoute
node_kinds.description: Gateway API TLSRoute for TLS passthrough routing.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Gateway
node_kinds.description: Gateway API Gateway resource managing network gateway instances.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Ingress
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Ingress exposing HTTP/HTTPS routes to services.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Route
node_kinds.description: OpenShift Route exposing routes to services.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Secret
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Secret storing sensitive data.

node_kinds.name: BHK_ConfigMap
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes ConfigMap storing non-sensitive configuration data.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Identity
node_kinds.description: Abstract principal kind shared by all identity types (ServiceAccount, User, Group, future cloud IAM).

node_kinds.name: BHK_ServiceAccount
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount providing pod identity for API access.

node_kinds.name: BHK_User
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes User identity synthesized from RBAC binding subjects.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Group
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Group identity synthesized from RBAC binding subjects.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Role
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes namespaced RBAC Role defining permission rules.

node_kinds.name: BHK_RoleBinding
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes RoleBinding granting a Role to subjects within a namespace.

node_kinds.name: BHK_ClusterRole
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes cluster-scoped RBAC ClusterRole defining permission rules.

node_kinds.name: BHK_ClusterRoleBinding
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes ClusterRoleBinding granting a ClusterRole to subjects cluster-wide.

node_kinds.name: BHK_PersistentVolume
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes PersistentVolume representing cluster-provisioned storage.

node_kinds.name: BHK_PersistentVolumeClaim
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim requesting storage from a PersistentVolume.

node_kinds.name: BHK_NetworkPolicy
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy controlling pod-level network traffic rules.

node_kinds.name: BHK_SecurityContextConstraint
node_kinds.description: OpenShift SecurityContextConstraint restricting pod security configurations.

node_kinds.name: BHK_ExternalSecret
node_kinds.description: External Secrets Operator ExternalSecret syncing secrets from external providers.

node_kinds.name: BHK_ClusterSecretStore
node_kinds.description: External Secrets Operator ClusterSecretStore defining a cluster-scoped secret backend.

node_kinds.name: BHK_SecretStore
node_kinds.description: External Secrets Operator SecretStore defining a namespaced secret backend.

node_kinds.name: BHK_CiliumNetworkPolicy
node_kinds.description: Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy controlling pod-level network traffic rules at Layer 3/4/7.

node_kinds.name: BHK_GlobalNetworkPolicy
node_kinds.description: Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy controlling cluster-wide network traffic rules.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Certificate
node_kinds.description: cert-manager Certificate requesting a TLS keypair be issued into a Secret.

node_kinds.name: BHK_Issuer
node_kinds.description: cert-manager Issuer defining a namespaced certificate signing authority.

node_kinds.name: BHK_ClusterIssuer
node_kinds.description: cert-manager ClusterIssuer defining a cluster-wide certificate signing authority.

node_kinds.name: BHK_IstioGateway
node_kinds.description: Istio Gateway (networking.istio.io) describing a mesh-managed load balancer's exposed ports and TLS termination.

node_kinds.name: BHK_VirtualService
node_kinds.description: Istio VirtualService defining traffic routing rules to destination Services.

node_kinds.name: BHK_PeerAuthentication
node_kinds.description: Istio PeerAuthentication configuring mTLS requirements for workloads; PERMISSIVE mode allows plaintext traffic.

node_kinds.name: BHK_AuthorizationPolicy
node_kinds.description: Istio AuthorizationPolicy controlling which principals may access selected workloads; an ALLOW action with no rules permits all traffic.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ScheduledOn
relationship_kinds.description: Pod is scheduled on a specific Node.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ManagedBy
relationship_kinds.description: Pod is managed by a workload controller (Deployment, DaemonSet, StatefulSet, Job, CronJob) or ExternalSecret manages a Secret.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_MountedBy
relationship_kinds.description: Secret, ConfigMap, or PVC is mounted by a Pod.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_BoundTo
relationship_kinds.description: PersistentVolume is bound to a PersistentVolumeClaim.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_Contains
relationship_kinds.description: Aggregate node contains individual resources or namespace-scoped aggregates.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_AppliesTo
relationship_kinds.description: NetworkPolicy applies to a Pod or aggregate.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_RoleBound
relationship_kinds.description: Structural edge linking a RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding to the Role or ClusterRole it references.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_EnforcedSCC
relationship_kinds.description: SecurityContextConstraint is enforced on a Pod.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_RoutesTo
relationship_kinds.description: Gateway, HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute, TCPRoute, TLSRoute, or Service routes traffic to a downstream target.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ExternalRoutesTo
relationship_kinds.description: External actor can reach a Service, Ingress, or Gateway from outside the cluster.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ExternalHostPort
relationship_kinds.description: External actor can reach a Node via an exposed hostPort on a Pod.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_HostPort
relationship_kinds.description: Pod exposes a hostPort on its scheduled Node.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_EnvVars
relationship_kinds.description: Secret or ConfigMap is injected into a Pod as environment variables.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_SAToken
relationship_kinds.description: Secret contains a ServiceAccount token, granting access to that identity.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_mountSA
relationship_kinds.description: Pod mounts a ServiceAccount token, allowing an attacker who controls the pod to use that identity.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_NSENTER
relationship_kinds.description: Privileged pod with SYS_ADMIN capability can use nsenter to escape to the host Node.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_PRIV_MOUNT
relationship_kinds.description: Privileged pod can mount the host filesystem and escape to the Node.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_SYS_PTRACE
relationship_kinds.description: Pod with SYS_PTRACE capability and shareProcessNamespace can inject into host processes.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_UMH_CORE_PATTERN
relationship_kinds.description: Pod can abuse usermode helper core_pattern to execute code on the Node.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_HOST_IPC
relationship_kinds.description: Pod shares the host IPC namespace, enabling access to host shared memory segments.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_HOST_NETWORK
relationship_kinds.description: Pod shares the host network namespace, enabling traffic sniffing and network policy bypass.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_SHARE_PROC_NS
relationship_kinds.description: Pod shares process namespace with other containers, enabling credential harvesting from /proc.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CE_VAR_LOG_SYMLINK
relationship_kinds.description: Pod can exploit /var/log symlink following to read arbitrary host files.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_MOUNT_CONTAINER_SOCKET
relationship_kinds.description: Pod mounts a container runtime socket, enabling full container management on the Node.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_hostMountSensitive
relationship_kinds.description: Pod has a host mount of sensitive directories, enabling lateral movement and information disclosure.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_mountedKubelet
relationship_kinds.description: Pod mounts the kubelet credential directory, enabling Node-level API access.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_PodExec
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has RBAC permissions to exec into pods, enabling direct command execution.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_PodAttach
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has RBAC permissions to attach to running container processes.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_PodDebug
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has RBAC permissions to create ephemeral debug containers in pods.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_PodPortForward
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has RBAC permissions to port-forward into pods for lateral movement.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_WorkloadCreate
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can create Pods or pod-creating workload controllers, enabling deployment of arbitrary pod specs.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_WorkloadPatch
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has patch/update permissions on Pods or workload controllers, enabling image replacement or spec modification.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_RBACCreate
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can create RoleBindings or ClusterRoleBindings, enabling privilege assignment.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_RBACEscalate
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has the escalate verb, allowing creation of roles with permissions beyond their own.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_RBACBind
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has the bind verb, allowing binding to roles with permissions beyond their own.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_Impersonate
relationship_kinds.description: Principal has RBAC permissions to impersonate another principal (User, Group, or ServiceAccount) via the Kubernetes impersonation API.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ReadSecret
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has get or list permissions on Secrets, exposing full secret values.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ReadConfigMap
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has get or list permissions on ConfigMaps.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_SATokenRequest
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can mint tokens for ServiceAccounts via the TokenRequest API.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_NodeProxy
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has nodes/proxy permission, enabling proxied requests to the Kubelet API.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_NodeProxyRCE
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has nodes/proxy GET permission, enabling remote code execution on any node via the Kubelet API.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_ReadLogs
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has pods/log permissions, enabling access to container logs which may contain sensitive data.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_SCCUse
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can use a SecurityContextConstraint via RBAC, enabling privileged pod creation under that SCC.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CAP_SYS_ADMIN
relationship_kinds.description: Container has CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability enabling privilege escalation and container escape.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CAP_NET_ADMIN
relationship_kinds.description: Container has CAP_NET_ADMIN capability enabling network interception and modification.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CAP_SYS_MODULE
relationship_kinds.description: Container has CAP_SYS_MODULE capability enabling kernel module loading.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CAP_SYS_PTRACE
relationship_kinds.description: Container has CAP_SYS_PTRACE capability enabling process tracing and code injection.

relationship_kinds.name: BHK_CAP_SYS_RAWIO
relationship_kinds.description: Container has CAP_SYS_RAWIO capability enabling raw I/O operations bypassing security controls.
